scope: Read-only producer/routing dependency audit after explicit GPU group verification. No autonomous character-admission claim.
facts_from_current_sources: CPU timing matching exists for multi_hit:N, but no battle emitter invokes it.
Normal HitEvent.rule defaults to an empty aimed-target rule, and boss.route maps that to one aimed add/body. Do not assume existing normal AoE/pierce add routing is complete.
Current typed landing adapter recognizes body and parts, raises for other target names when observed, and does not publish the hit_add branch.
GPU world compilation rejects summon, shield, interrupt and vanish pattern kinds before running.
GPU group threshold delivery is now implemented for explicit typed inputs; normal shot boundaries and matched-target child routing remain pending.
next_common_boundaries: Stable actor identity and spawn generation registry for body, parts, adds and later projectile/shield targets. Keep existing part identities stable for counter compatibility.
One explicit shot scope around actual weapon landing batches; do not assign a new group to every pellet. Stamp only the participating parent weapon packets.
Freeze or retain the sealed target set through synchronous child callbacks before adding a matched-target selector; do not point all matched targets at the boss sentinel.
Declare and verify which actor kinds count as separate targets. Parts/cover interpretation needs evidence; the collector must not invent a default.
Audit AoE/pierce routing across supported world actors, then require nonzero raw-skill activations before lifting the normal multi_hit admission block.
